rules.statement: A mortgagee cannot compel a puisne encumbrancer who acquires his title after the entering up of the decree in the mortgage action to be a party to the suit, and such an encumbrancer's failure to register the instrument under which he derives his title or register his address does not make him bound by the decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "A mortgagee cannot possibly make a puisne encumbrancer who acquires his title after the entering up of the decree in the mortgage action a party to the suit and a puisne encumbrancer who acquires his title subsequent to the decree cannot possibly register the instrument under which he derives his title or register his address so that it may be in the registers at the date of filing of the plaint."
